name: Nord Wave 2
description: Nord Wave 2 four-layer performance synthesizer: every control of its manual's MIDI controller list.

Every parameter is a row of the manual's MIDI controller list, with its printed name, sent as the control change it prints on the channel variable. Nothing here has been sent to a real instrument yet.
The list prints controller numbers only: every value is 0 - 127, and a setting chosen from a list (a model, a waveform, an effect type) is a number here, not a choice.
Set the channel variable to the Global MIDI channel or a Layer's own, as the manual describes for the Wave 2's four Layers.
Messages the list gives to two rows, both laid out: CC 94: Delay Tempo Tap/Set, Delay Rate. CEditor sends either, and follows neither when the instrument sends it.
Left out, the pedals, the wheel and bank select: 0 Bank Select MSB, 32 Bank Select LSB, 64 Sustain, 11 Ctrl Pedal (Expression).

coverage.inboundControllers: the instrument sends these same messages when its panel is used, where its MIDI settings allow
